test_tokenizer_tokenize: test the Tokenizer class to tokenize a sentence into lowercase word tokens
test_tokenizer_byte_offsets: test the Tokenizer class with use_byte_offsets to get token start and end byte positions
test_wordpiece_tokenize: test the WordPieceTokenizer to tokenize text into subword pieces using a vocabulary file
test_gpt2_bpe_tokenize: test the GPT2BPETokenizer to tokenize text into GPT-2 BPE token IDs with byte offsets
test_sentencepiece_decode: test the SPEandWordTokenizer to decode tokenized SentencePiece tokens back into the original string
